physical_source_generation.scope: physical source data generation and saved metadata extraction; no learned performance
physical_source_generation.state_definition: 0 is normalized scale start and 1 is normalized full scale; normalized 0 need not mean physical reading 0.

cost.accounting_note: Subprocess wall times include process startup and are not GPU kernel time or CPU core time. The initial failed preparation is counted separately. End-to-end time includes the stopped interval.

limitations: This stage changes state coverage in existing source scenes; it adds no background diversity.
The result records source data integrity and execution costs, not a model generalization result.

cohort_definitions.source: Frozen published common_ordinary1495, r8_ordinary1497 and old_severe_union6 membership; not recomputed from new errors.

limitations: Single seed and four new epochs per arm on already viewed external development sets; no significance, blind-test or universal mechanism claim.
Checkpoint selection uses source1506 only; the fixed last4 checkpoint is reported separately and is not promoted using external labels.
v5 local57 and v6 feedback48 have different training histories; their contextual difference is not an isolated architecture effect.
Saved initialization/load and execution metadata are audited; model tensors were not loaded again and no new CNN, GPU, backward or optimizer work was performed.
Endpoint supervision is verified by direct saved-contract equality, declared replacement, and original edge mapping; rendered GT composition checks were retained rather than repeated.

The canonical saved data_contract.edges list is sorted by independent new IDs and is not the loader sampling sequence. The exact 8192 mapped directed pairs are unchanged; a separate raw input-metadata check also confirmed the original ordered training-pair sequence is preserved under the frozen 512-ID mapping.
RF100 scalar targets were derived offline from four-point annotations; model inference used ROI RGB only.

input_metadata_evidence.canonical_saved_contract_edges: sorted by sample ID; not the loader sampling sequence
input_metadata_evidence.ordered_raw_pair_check_scope: Separate CPU-only raw old/new train_edges.jsonl metadata comparison under the frozen 512-ID mapping; no model or GT recomputation.
